item.title: Heat Instead of Sunlight: UC Davis Framework Could Double Solar Efficiency
item.description: A research team at the University of California, Davis, has unveiled a theoretical framework for a thermophotovoltaic (TPV) system that could redefine the boundaries of renewable energy. By capturing heat rather than direct sunlight, the system achieves a simulated power conversion efficiency of 50%, effectively doubling the performance of today’s leading commercial silicon solar panels. item.title: Sungrow and Delta Capacity sign pact for deploying 1 GWh BESS
item.description: Sungrow and Delta Capacity have signed a 1 GWh framework agreement for battery energy storage systems (BESS), further expanding their partnership in Europe’s rapidly growing energy storage market. The agreement was signed at the Energy Storage Summit held in London. Under the deal, Sungrow will supply its PowerTitan 2.0 energy storage solution, with project deliveries and deployment scheduled within 2026. item.title: Karnataka Budget 2026 Targets 3 GW Solar, 2 GWh BESS
item.description: The Karnataka government has unveiled its 2026–27 budget, placing a strong emphasis on decentralised energy systems, rural power sustainability, and renewable energy expansion. The latest budget extended Rs. 48,000 crore electricity subsidy to benefit 36 lakh farmers across the state.
